chal-canon1-en: Should the canons of the Holy Fathers made in every synod even until now remain in force?
chal-canon2-en: May a bishop ordain for money, put to sale a grace which cannot be sold, or nominate church officers for money?
chal-canon3-en: May a bishop, clergyman, or monk hire possessions, engage in business, or occupy himself in worldly engagements for gain?
chal-canon4-en: May anyone build or found a monastery or oratory contrary to the will of the city’s bishop, and are monks in every city and district subject to the bishop?
chal-canon5-en: Concerning bishops or clergymen who go about from city to city, do the canons enacted by the Holy Fathers still retain their force?
chal-canon6-en: May a presbyter, deacon, or anyone of the ecclesiastical order be ordained at large without being particularly appointed to a church, martyry, or monastery?
chal-canon7-en: May those once enrolled among the clergy or made monks accept a military charge or any secular dignity without returning to their first calling?
chal-canon8-en: Must the clergy of poor-houses, monasteries, and martyries remain under the authority of the bishops in every city according to the tradition of the holy Fathers?
chal-canon9-en: If a clergyman has a matter against another clergyman, must he first lay it before his own bishop rather than forsake him and run to secular courts?
chal-canon10-en: Is it lawful for a clergyman to be enrolled at the same time in the churches of two cities?
chal-canon11-en: Should the poor and those needing assistance travel, after examination, with letters merely pacifical from the church, and not with letters commendatory?
chal-canon12-en: May a bishop, by means of imperial rescripts, divide one province into two so that there are two metropolitans in one province?
chal-canon13-en: May strange and unknown clergymen without letters commendatory from their own bishop officiate in another city?
chal-canon14-en: Where readers and singers are permitted to marry, may any of them take a wife that is heterodox?
chal-canon15-en: May a woman receive the laying on of hands as a deaconess under forty years of age, and if after ministering she marries, is she anathematized along with the man united to her?
chal-canon16-en: Is it lawful for a virgin who has dedicated herself to the Lord God, or for monks, to marry?
chal-canon17-en: Shall outlying or rural parishes in every province remain subject to the bishops who now have jurisdiction over them, especially if governed peaceably for thirty years?
chal-canon18-en: If clergymen or monks are detected conspiring, banding together, or hatching plots against their bishops or fellow clergy, must they be deposed from their rank?
chal-canon19-en: Must the bishops of every province assemble twice in the year where the metropolitan approves, to settle ecclesiastical matters that have arisen?
chal-canon20-en: Is it lawful for clergymen officiating in one church to be appointed to the church of another city, except those driven by necessity from their own country?
chal-canon21-en: Are clergymen and laymen bringing charges against bishops or clergymen to be received loosely and without examination as accusers, or must their own character first be investigated?
chal-canon22-en: Is it lawful for clergymen, after the death of their bishop, to seize what belongs to him?
chal-canon23-en: May clergymen and monks without authority from their own bishop—or while under his excommunication—remain long in imperial Constantinople raising disturbances and troubling the ecclesiastical state?
chal-canon24-en: Must monasteries once consecrated with the bishop’s consent remain monasteries forever, with their property preserved, and never again become secular dwellings?
chal-canon25-en: Must the ordinations of bishops take place within three months, unless an inevitable necessity requires the term of delay to be prolonged?
chal-canon26-en: Must every church having a bishop also have a steward from among its own clergy to manage church business under the bishop’s sanction?
chal-canon27-en: Shall those who forcibly carry off women under pretence of marriage, and the aiders or abettors of such ravishers, be degraded if clergymen and anathematized if laymen?
chal-canon28-en: Following the Fathers and the canon of the One Hundred and Fifty Bishops at Constantinople, does the most holy throne of New Rome receive equal privileges with old Rome in ecclesiastical matters?
chal-canon29-en: Is it sacrilege to degrade a bishop to the rank of a presbyter, and if bishops are removed from episcopal functions for just cause, ought they still to have the position of a presbyter?
chal-canon30-en: May the Egyptian bishops postpone for the present their subscription to Archbishop Leo’s letter until the ordination of a new archbishop of Alexandria, without opposing the Catholic Faith?
con-s1-on-the-matters-to-be-treated-in-t: Was this general council at Constance rightly convoked to attend, with the advice of the sacred synod, to the peace, exaltation, and reform of the Church and the ending of the schism?
con-s2-john-xxiii-publicly-offers-to-res: Did John XXIII publicly offer to resign the papacy?
con-s3-decrees-on-the-integrity-and-auth: Was the sacred council of Constance dissolved by the departure of the pope from Constance, or does it continue in its integrity and authority even if decrees to the contrary are made?
con-s4-decrees-of-the-council-on-its-aut: Does a general council legitimately assembled in the Holy Spirit, representing the Catholic Church militant, have power immediately from Christ, so that everyone of whatever dignity, even papal, is bound to obey it in matters of faith and ending the schism?
con-s4-next-it-was-declared-and-decided-: For the sake of unity, should new cardinals not be created, and are those not publicly held as cardinals at the pope’s departure from Constance not to be regarded as cardinals?
con-s5-decrees-of-the-council-concerning: Does a general council legitimately assembled in the Holy Spirit, representing the Catholic Church militant, have power immediately from Christ, binding everyone of whatever dignity, even papal, in matters of faith, ending schism, and general reform of the Church of God?
con-s6-at-this-session-there-were-among-: May the office of proctor be admitted in the matter of Pope John XXIII’s renunciation of the papacy, and is Jerome of Prague to be cited?
con-s7-at-this-session-it-was-decreed-th: Should Pope John be publicly summoned, and should the summons of Jerome of Prague, charged with contumacy, be repeated?
con-s8-p1-en: Does this general synod of Constance, representing the Catholic Church and legitimately assembled in the Holy Spirit, act for the eradication of the present schism, the elimination of errors and heresies, and the reform of the Church?
con-s9-pope-john-is-publicly-summoned-fo: Is Pope John to be publicly summoned a second time, and is an inquiry against him to be decreed?
con-s10-john-xxiii-is-summoned-for-the-t: Is John XXIII to be summoned a third time, accused of contumacy, and suspended from the papacy?
con-s11-pope-john-xxiii-is-publicly-char: Is Pope John XXIII to be publicly charged, with forty-four articles produced against him?
con-s12-decree-stating-that-the-process-: If the apostolic see becomes vacant, may the process of electing the next supreme pontiff begin without the deliberation and consent of this sacred general council?
con-s12-sentence-deposing-pope-john-xxii: By definitive sentence after the articles, proofs, and process against him, including his secret and suspicious departure from Constance and the sacred council, is Pope John XXIII deposed from the papacy?
con-s12-decree-to-the-effect-that-none-o: For the good of unity in God’s Church, may Baldassare de Cossa (John XXIII), Angelo Correr (Gregory XII), or Peter de Luna (Benedict XIII) ever be re-elected as pope?
con-s13-condemnation-of-communion-under-: Ought the Christian people to receive the holy sacrament of the Eucharist under the forms of both bread and wine, and may the laity communicate under wine and even after a meal without the need of a fast, contrary to the Church’s approved custom?
con-s13-that-no-priest-under-pain-of-exc: May a priest, under pain of excommunication, communicate the people under the forms of both bread and wine?
con-s14-uniting-of-the-followers-of-pope: For the reunion of the Church under Christ as head, may the two obediences claiming John XXIII and Gregory XII as pope be united, accepting Gregory XII’s convoking and authorizing acts insofar as they serve that reunion?
con-s14-decree-stating-that-the-election: Must the next election of the Roman pontiff be made in the manner, form, place, time, and way decided by the sacred council, and must the council not be dissolved until that election has been made?
con-s14-the-council-approves-gregory-xii: Is Gregory XII’s cession, renunciation, and resignation of any right, title, and possession he had regarding the papacy to be accepted, approved, and commended?
con-s15-sentence-condemning-j-hus-to-the: Is John Hus to be relinquished to the judgment of the secular authority and the secular court?
con-s15-sentence-condemning-john-petit-s: Can and ought any tyrant to be killed licitly and meritoriously by any of his vassals or subjects, even by plots or flattery, notwithstanding any oath or treaty, and without waiting for a sentence or command from any judge?
con-s16-deliberation-about-the-council-s: Are the council’s legates due to depart with the emperor Sigismund for Spain, and may minor deliberations about the conduct of the council’s business proceed?
con-s17-the-emperor-s-imminent-departure: Is the emperor’s imminent departure from the council to be treated of, and does the council offer prayers for his success?
con-s18-decrees-about-various-matters-to: May judges be given power to decide cases in pairs, must bulls of the council be obeyed, and are forgers of conciliar bulls to be punished like forgers of apostolic letters?
con-s19-jerome-of-prague-finally-abjures: Notwithstanding safe-conducts of emperors and kings, may a competent judge inquire into heresy, and shall those with benefices attending the council receive the fruits of their benefices in their absence?
con-s20-a-warning-is-decreed-against-the: Is a warning to be decreed against the duke of Austria on behalf of the bishop of Trent?
con-s22-the-treaty-of-narbonne-between-t: Is the treaty of Narbonne confirmed, so that the king of Aragon withdraws obedience from Benedict XIII and recognises the council of Constance through his envoys?
con-s23-beginning-of-the-process-against: Is the process against Peter de Luna, called Benedict XIII in his obedience, to begin?
con-s24-a-citation-against-peter-de-luna: Is a citation against Peter de Luna, called Benedict XIII in his obedience, to be decreed?
con-s25-p1-en: Are the envoys of the Spanish count of Foix united with the council in accordance with the terms of the treaty of Narbonne?
con-s26-p1-en: Are the envoys of the king of Navarre united with the council in accordance with the terms of the treaty of Narbonne?
con-s27-the-dispute-between-frederick-du: Is the dispute between Frederick, duke of Austria, and the bishop of Trent to be discussed, with a report on carrying out the warning earlier decreed?
con-s28-the-trent-dispute-is-concluded-f: Are the articles of Narbonne concerning the unity of the Church, agreed between emperor Sigismund and the council’s envoys and those of Benedict XIII’s obedience, published and in force for that unity?
con-s29-peter-de-luna-is-accused-of-cont: Is Peter de Luna accused of contumacy?
con-s30-the-process-against-peter-de-lun: Does the process against Peter de Luna continue?
con-s31-a-warning-is-decreed-against-phi: Is a warning to be decreed against Philip, count of Vertus, at the request of the bishop of Asti?
con-s32-peter-de-luna-is-again-accused-o: Is Peter de Luna again accused of contumacy, and is an inquiry about him to be established?
con-s33-the-process-against-peter-de-lun: Does the process against Peter de Luna, deemed contumacious, continue?
con-s34-everything-is-made-ready-for-the: Is everything made ready for the condemnation of Peter de Luna?
con-s35-the-envoys-of-the-king-of-castil: Are the envoys of the king of Castile united with the council in accordance with the treaty of Narbonne?
con-s36-it-is-decreed-that-peter-de-luna: Is Peter de Luna to be cited to hear the council’s sentence?
con-s37-definitive-sentence-whereby-pete: Is Peter de Luna, called Benedict XIII, by definitive sentence divested of any claim to the papacy for fostering and continuing the schism and disturbing the universal Church?
con-s38-decree-about-the-right-to-vote-o: Do the deputies of the kings of Castile and Aragon have the right to vote as decreed when agreement among them had not previously been reached?
con-s39-on-general-councils-en: Is the frequent holding of general councils a pre-eminent means of cultivating the Lord’s patrimony, and shall general councils henceforth be held first in five years, then in seven, and thereafter every ten years?
con-s39-provision-to-guard-against-futur: If in the future two or more persons claim to be supreme pontiffs, must the date of the council be brought forward to within a year, and must prelates assemble without summons to end the schism?
con-s39-on-the-profession-to-be-made-by-: Must whoever is elected Roman pontiff make a public confession and profession of the faith and of the rites to be observed regarding the Church’s sacraments before his electors, before the election is published?
con-s39-that-prelates-may-not-be-transla: May bishops and superiors henceforth be translated unwillingly without a grave and reasonable cause inquired into and decided after the person has been summoned?
con-s39-on-spoils-and-procurations-en: May papal reservations, and the exacting of procurations due to ordinaries by reason of visitation, and of spoils on deceased prelates and clerics, henceforth occur or be attempted?
con-s40-reforms-to-be-made-by-the-pope-t: Is the future supreme Roman pontiff, together with the sacred council, bound to reform the Church in its head and in the Roman curia before the council is dissolved, under the articles put forward by the nations?
con-s40-that-the-election-of-the-roman-p: Notwithstanding the absence of Peter de Luna’s cardinals after his notorious expulsion, may the synod proceed to the election of the Roman pontiff on its own authority according to what it has decided?
con-s40-on-the-manner-and-form-of-electi: Is the election of the future Roman and supreme pontiff to be held in the manner and form decided by the sacred general synod of Constance with the consent of the cardinals and the nations?
con-s41-everything-is-prepared-for-the-s: With everything prepared for the conclave, is cardinal Oddo Colonna elected pontiff as Martin V?
con-s42-in-this-session-a-bull-of-martin: Is Martin V’s bull regarding Baldassare Cossa—formerly pope, earlier deprived and imprisoned but now to be set free—approved?
con-s43-certain-statutes-promulgated-on-: Are exemptions from the jurisdiction of ordinaries first granted after Gregory XI’s death to churches, monasteries, and persons not previously exempt revoked with the council’s approval?
con-s44-decree-on-the-place-of-the-next-: Is the city of Pavia deputed and assigned, with the consent and approval of the council, as the place for the next general council?
con-s45-sentence-dissolving-the-council-: Is the council dissolved for certain, reasonable, and just reasons, with permission for participants to return home and with a grant of full absolution of sins once in life and at the hour of death?
eph-canon4-en: If any of the clergy fall away and publicly or privately presume to maintain the doctrines of Nestorius or Celestius, are they to be deposed?
eph-canon6-en: If any attempt to set aside the orders made by the holy Synod at Ephesus, do bishops or clergymen absolutely forfeit their office, and are laymen excommunicated?
eph-anathema1-en: Is the Emmanuel very God, and is the Holy Virgin therefore the Mother of God (Theotokos), inasmuch as in the flesh she bore the Word of God made flesh?
eph-anathema2-en: Is the Word of God the Father united hypostatically to flesh, and with that flesh of his own is he one only Christ, both God and man at the same time?
eph-anathema5-en: Is the Christ a Theophorus (God-bearing) man, or rather very God as an only Son through nature, because the Word was made flesh and has a share in flesh and blood as we do?
eph-anathema6-en: Is the Word of God the Father the God or Lord of Christ, or rather to be confessed as at the same time both God and Man, since the Word was made flesh?
eph-anathema7-en: Is Jesus as man only energized by the Word of God, with the glory of the Only-begotten attributed to him as something not properly his?
eph-decree-nestorius-en: Is Nestorius excluded from the episcopal dignity and from all priestly communion for holding and publishing impious doctrines?
eph-decree-creed-en: Is it unlawful for any man to bring forward, write, or compose a different Faith as a rival to that established by the holy Fathers assembled with the Holy Ghost in Nicaea?
eph-definition-messalians-en: Are all things contained in the Constantinopolitan synodical chart concerning the Messalians (Euchetes or Enthusiasts) confirmed and in no way to be rescinded?
flo-basel-s1-p1-en: In execution of Constance’s decree that general councils be frequent, was the succession of councils leading to Basel rightly established for the glory of God and the exaltation of the Catholic faith?
flo-ferrara-s1-declaration-of-cardinal-n: Is the sacred synod translated from Basel to Ferrara legitimately assembled and continued for all the purposes for which Basel was convened, including being the ecumenical council for union of West and East?
flo-basel-s1-establishment-of-the-holy-c: Was the holy council of Basel established and solemnly begun under the apostolic legate for the purposes enjoined by Pope Eugenius IV?
flo-basel-s1-purpose-of-the-council-of-b: Are the ends of this holy synod the banishment of heresies and shining of Catholic truth, the pacification of the Christian people freed from wars, and the reformation of the Church?
flo-basel-s2-p1-en: Does the holy general synod of Basel, representing the Church militant and legitimately assembled in the Holy Spirit, act for the extirpation of heresies, reformation of morals in head and members, and pacification among Christians?
flo-ferrara-s2-p1-en: Does this holy universal synod at Ferrara, authorized by Pope Eugenius IV and representing the universal Church, adhere to the foundation of Peter’s rock and seek to preserve the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace?
flo-basel-s2-decree-that-the-council-of-: By the decrees of Constance and of Siena and by apostolic authority, was the sacred synod of Basel duly and legitimately begun and assembled, inserting Constance’s declarations on conciliar power among its decrees?
flo-ferrara-s2-p2-en: Were the translation and declaration from Basel to Ferrara legitimate, just, and reasonable from urgent necessity to remove an obstacle to East–West union, prevent a threatening schism, and benefit the Christian commonwealth?
flo-ferrara-s2-p3-en: Since urgent necessity moved Eugenius to the translation, does that matter in no way fall within the decrees of the eighth, eleventh, or any other session of the former council of Basel?
flo-ferrara-s2-p4-en: Is the assembly at Basel, and every other assembly convened there or elsewhere under the name of a general council, a spurious gathering and conventicle that can in no way exist with the authority of a general council?
flo-ferrara-s2-p5-en: Are each and all of the things done in Basel in the name of a general council after the translation, and whatever may be attempted thereafter in that name, invalid, quashed, null, and of no force or moment?
flo-ferrara-s2-p6-en: If something useful has been achieved at Basel after the translation in the matter of the Bohemians, may that be approved and defects supplied?
flo-ferrara-s2-p7-en: Are those who bound themselves by oath to the former synod of Basel absolved and dispensed from those oaths insofar as they impede free obedience to the present holy synod at Ferrara?
flo-ferrara-s2-p8-en: May anyone of whatever rank, except by jurisdiction of the apostolic see, disturb or molest in their dignities, offices, benefices, or goods those present at this synod or following the Roman curia to it?
flo-ferrara-s2-p9-en: Do those who molest persons at the synod in their dignities, benefices, or goods, or confer those goods on others by pretended deprivation, automatically incur excommunication, suspension, and interdict reserved to the Roman pontiff?
flo-ferrara-s2-p10-en: Are those who do not repent within three days by restoring impeded dignities and benefices, and those who accept such unlawful collations, automatically deprived of their other benefices?
flo-ferrara-s2-p11-en: Must each and all who are obliged by law or custom to take part in general councils come as soon as possible to the present synod at Ferrara?
flo-basel-s3-impossibility-of-the-dissol: Was the alleged dissolution of the council of Basel contrary to Constance and of no effect, so that the dissolution could not be made and the council must proceed?
flo-basel-s3-p2-en: Must Pope Eugenius revoke the alleged dissolution of Basel, desist from every obstacle against the council, favour and assist it, and come in person or by plenipotentiary within three months?
flo-basel-s3-p3-en: Must the cardinals press the pope concerning Basel, favour and aid the council, and themselves come to it within three months under canonical monition?
flo-basel-s3-p4-en: Must prelates, clerics, princes, and the faithful, under pain of excommunication, report and notify the council’s monitions to the pope and cardinals in person or by affixed notices?
flo-basel-s3-p5-en: If personal intimation cannot be effected, is the decree of admonition and citation, after being affixed to the doors of Basel’s cathedral, considered performed for all its effects after four months?
flo-basel-s3-p6-en: Despite delays, may the council proceed in an orderly manner on the basis of Constance’s summons, and are citations decreed for prelates, generals of orders, and inquisitors of heresy?
flo-basel-s4-p1-en: Is a safe-conduct granted to those from Bohemia and Moravia sent to the general council of Basel, within the stated number, for coming, staying, and returning?
flo-basel-s4-p2-en: May the Bohemian envoys freely propose and explain at Basel the four articles they insist on, support them from Scripture and the doctors, and discuss them charitably without impediment?
flo-basel-s4-p3-en: Does the Bohemian safe-conduct include all clauses necessary for full safety in coming, staying, and returning, even if some heinous crime by one of them would otherwise annul security for that person alone?
flo-basel-s4-p4-en: May each ambassador leave Basel to take the air and send messengers as needed under the council’s escort, and may the council’s side not employ local prejudice against the four articles in sermons and conferences?
flo-basel-s4-p5-en: Is the safe-conduct’s security promised also with respect to the Roman pontiff, king Sigismund, cardinals, prelates, princes, universities, and communities, so that those coming under it are not harmed by them?
flo-basel-s4-p6-en: If the apostolic see becomes vacant while the council is in progress, may the election of a pope be held outside the council?
flo-basel-s4-p7-en: Have the cardinals of the holy Roman Church been summoned to Basel as necessary for the extirpation of heresies, peace among Christ’s people, and the reformation of morals?
flo-basel-s5-in-this-session-there-were-: Are rules approved about the council’s organization—cases and the procurator of the faith, judges for general examination of cases, that members may not be tried outside the council’s place, and appointment of officials?
flo-florence-s5-decree-translating-the-c: Must the site of an ecumenical council provide healthy air among human necessities, lest pestilent contagion force those present to depart unfinished and the absent refuse to attend?
flo-florence-s5-p2-en: Though union of East and West was begun at Ferrara, may transferral be considered when plague afflicts the city?
flo-florence-s5-p3-en: Since the plague continues and is feared to strengthen in spring and summer, with the agreement of the emperor John Palaeologus and patriarch Joseph and the council’s approval, must a move be made to a non-infected place?
flo-florence-s5-p4-en: Is this ecumenical synod transferred from Ferrara to Florence, with the full securities and safe-conducts earlier given, as a free, safe, peaceful city with healthy air and easy access for easterners and westerners?
flo-basel-s6-this-session-was-devoted-to: Is the petition of the promoters of the council against the pope and the cardinals to be read and considered?
flo-basel-s7-p1-en: If a vacancy of the apostolic see occurs during this sacred council, is the earlier Basel decree on electing a Roman pontiff at the council to be clarified so the Lyons ten-day conclave interval does not unduly restrict the election?
flo-florence-s7-decree-of-the-council-of: As Moses warned the people to depart from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, must the Christian people depart from the tents of those at Basel who plot schism against the Church’s unity?
flo-florence-s7-p2-en: Must the people of Christ depart from the tents of those wicked men at Basel who plot to breach the unity of holy Church and may seduce the unwary with their deceits?
flo-florence-s7-p3-en: Had the council of Basel lapsed into tyranny—with forced attendance, extorted votes, conspiracies, rivalry with the papacy, and innumerable irregularities by the ignorant, fugitives, and rebels—so that its impiety was foreseeable?
flo-florence-s7-p4-en: Was the most holy work of union with the eastern Church endangered by factious persons, and for these and other just reasons stated in the decree of translation was action required with the cardinals’ advice?
flo-florence-s7-p5-en: With the approval of archbishops, bishops, abbots, and other prelates, masters, and doctors, was the council of Basel transferred to Ferrara, where an ecumenical council of the western and eastern Church was established?
flo-florence-s7-p6-en: When plague continued unabated, was the council transferred to Florence, where after discussions the nearly five-hundred-year schism was removed and the most holy union of the Greeks and the Latins happily achieved?
flo-florence-s7-p7-en: For this union, is fervent thanks due to the eternal God, with joy shared among the faithful, as peoples of many races hasten to the one utterance of the divine truth?
flo-florence-s7-p8-en: By God’s providence, have representatives of the Armenians come with full powers to the apostolic see and this holy council, regarding the pope as blessed Peter and the holy see as mother and mistress of all the faithful?
flo-florence-s7-p9-en: In the course of this divine undertaking of union, have troubles, attacks, and persecutions come not from Turks or Saracens but from those who call themselves Christians?
flo-florence-s7-p10-en: Have desperate men at Basel, knowing God and hating him, acted against the pope and the Church of God under the cloak of reform while spreading their poisons?
flo-florence-s7-p11-en: Did the authors of the scandals at Basel fail in their promises to the Greeks, who wished to proceed to the place legally chosen for the ecumenical council with the emperor John Palaeologus and patriarch Joseph?
flo-florence-s7-p12-en: When they learnt of the Greeks’ coming, did those at Basel dare to decree against the pope and cardinals a detestable admonition or citation so as to block the holy work of union?
flo-florence-s7-p13-en: When the emperor and patriarch were already on their way for holy union, did those at Basel produce a sacrilegious sentence of suspension from the administration of the papacy?
flo-florence-s7-p14-en: Alleging obedience to those decrees, did they proclaim three propositions which they term truths of the faith, seemingly to make heretics of the pope and adherents of the apostolic see?
flo-florence-s7-p15-en: Is it a truth of the Catholic faith that a general council representing the universal Church has authority over a pope and anyone else, and that a pope cannot without its consent dissolve, prorogue, or transfer such a council?
flo-florence-s7-p16-en: By calling these propositions truths of the faith, did those at Basel give Constance an evil meaning opposed to its true teaching, drawing on a perverse interpretation of Scripture and the holy fathers?
flo-florence-s7-p17-en: Did those at Basel, after the manner of Dioscorus and the infamous synod of Ephesus, proceed to a declaratory sentence of deprivation of the pope from the supreme apostolate?
flo-florence-s7-p18-en: Is it impious inconsistency to praise the holy union of East and West as the Church’s greatest good and yet overthrow it by schismatic sentence against the pope who advanced that union?
flo-florence-s7-p19-en: Must the pope and council, as far as they can, take measures to eliminate from God’s Church the execrable impiety of those striving to set up an abomination of desolation by their schism?
flo-florence-s7-p20-en: May improperly conducted councils, even those involving universal pontiffs, be annulled, as when Leo moved from the second Ephesus to establish Chalcedon?
flo-florence-s7-p21-en: Is the Ferrara decree renewed at Florence, declaring that each and every person at Basel who in the name of a pretended council dared those scandalous deeds against the translation is under the penalties then declared?
flo-florence-s7-p22-en: Are all things done or attempted by those at Basel after the translation—especially in their so-called sessions of deprivation—null, quashed, invalid, and of no effect?
flo-florence-s7-p23-en: Are the Basel propositions about conciliar authority over the pope, understood in their perverse sense, and their so-called sentence of deprivation, condemned and rejected as impious, scandalous, and tending to open schism?
flo-basel-s8-decree-that-there-ought-to-: Just as there is only one holy Catholic Church, can there be only one general council representing that Church, so that during Basel’s lifetime another general council cannot exist elsewhere?
flo-basel-s9-this-session-was-entirely-t: Is the emperor Sigismund to be solemnly received by the council?
flo-florence-s9-monition-of-the-council-: Must specially grave crimes that lead to public division of the people not be passed over in silence or left completely unpunished, lest divine patience be provoked to wrath?
flo-florence-s9-p2-en: Can one who does not hold the unity of the Church have God as his father, and is the person who divides the Church convicted of lacerating the body of Christ?
flo-florence-s9-p3-en: Are those who produce schism and, abandoning the true spouse of the Church, set up a pseudo-bishop bereft of hope and punished by God’s indignation?
flo-florence-s9-p4-en: Was the chronic schism that afflicted God’s Church finally settled at Constance by God’s mercy and the labours of that holy general council?
flo-florence-s9-p5-en: After those remaining at Basel failed to fulfil their promise to the Greeks, and the emperor and patriarch with eastern prelates turned instead toward the pope’s council, did Basel’s opposition deepen?
flo-florence-s9-p6-en: Did those at Basel issue against the pope a sacrilegious decree of suspension from the administration of the papacy when they learnt that the emperor, patriarch, and other easterners were coming?
flo-florence-s9-p7-en: Despite Basel’s wicked attempts, did divine mercy grant that the schism of the Greeks and the eastern Church, lasting almost five hundred years, be healed through the pope and this sacred council?
flo-florence-s9-p8-en: Was Amadeus, once duke of Savoy, the leader and architect of the nefarious deed of setting up a rival claim against the true pope?
flo-florence-s9-p9-en: Was Amadeus set up as an idol in God’s Church by that wicked assembly at Basel, through insatiable greed and schismatic election?
flo-florence-s9-p10-en: Is the crime of setting up Amadeus as a rival to the true Roman pontiff so heinous that no complaint can equal the grossness of the act?
flo-florence-s9-p11-en: Is the present hour one not merely for lament but for remedy against this schism?
flo-florence-s9-p12-en: Must holy mother Church, basking in true unity under her undoubted spouse the pope, cry out to him and to the fathers of this ecumenical council for help against the schism?
flo-florence-s9-p13-en: Must the pope and sacred synod, following Moses and Pope Leo, tell the Christian people to depart from the tents of these impious men and deal with them as Leo dealt with Dioscorus at Chalcedon?
flo-florence-s9-p14-en: Must this new frenzy against the pope and the holy Roman Church be avenged with condign penalties by the authority of almighty God and of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul?
flo-florence-s9-p15-en: May Amadeus and all his electors and supporters be cast out like an antichrist and invader, with no appeal, deprived of every ecclesiastical or secular rank and dignity?
flo-florence-s9-p16-en: Does the grace of almighty God protect those who execrate these heresiarchs and their antichrist, acknowledge the pope as Christ’s vicar and spouse of the Church, and obey him with devout faith?
flo-florence-s9-p17-en: Upon learning of so great an impiety, especially Amadeus’s claim, was grief and pastoral concern the right response before proceeding to censure?
flo-florence-s9-p18-en: Even though these crimes are public and notorious, may further precaution still be taken before declaring the penalties?
flo-florence-s9-p19-en: Through the tender mercy of God and the precious blood of Christ, must Amadeus and his electors be exhorted from the depths of the heart to abandon their schism?
flo-florence-s9-p20-en: With the sacred council’s approval, are Amadeus and his electors, believers, adherents, receivers, and supporters to be demanded and warned under threat of penalties if love of justice does not withdraw them from sin?
flo-florence-s9-p21-en: Within fifty days after publication of this letter, must Amadeus cease acting and designating himself as Roman pontiff and cease using papal insignia?
flo-florence-s9-p22-en: Must Amadeus and his electors, believers, adherents, and supporters hold, recognize, and reverence Eugenius as the true Roman pontiff and vicar of Christ and obey him as father and pastor of their souls?
flo-florence-s9-p23-en: If Amadeus and his supporters do not effectively fulfil these points within the appointed time, do they automatically incur the stated penalties from then as from now?
flo-florence-s9-p24-en: On the fifteenth day after that interval, must the aforesaid supporters appear in person before the pope and council to be seen and heard, as now cited for that day?
flo-florence-s9-p25-en: Whether or not they come, if they have not shown that they obeyed, may proceedings go forward to declaring the penalties notwithstanding their contumacy or absence?
flo-florence-s9-p26-en: Does this monition, promulgated on the doors and gates, have as much value and binding force as if intimated to each warned person in person and in their presence?
flo-florence-s9-p27-en: Are the warned and cited persons reassured that the council and Roman curia are a safe place for them in coming, staying, and returning, so they may not allege danger as an excuse?
flo-basel-s10-this-session-was-almost-en: Is the accusation of contumacy of the pope to be read and pursued?
flo-florence-s10-eugenius-iv-exhorts-the: Ought public sinners to be publicly censured so that others may stand in fear, and must the members of the synod at Basel desist from their schism after such public censure?
flo-basel-s11-for-the-permanent-validity: Obeying Constance’s decree beginning “The frequent,” must the Roman pontiff take part in general councils in person or by a legate a latere chosen in consultation, so that obstacles to frequent councils are removed?
flo-basel-s11-that-everybody-is-free-to-: Notwithstanding any prohibition, even from the Roman pontiff, is there freedom for absolutely all persons—including cardinals—to go to general councils, and is the Roman pontiff bound to grant them permission if they request it?
flo-basel-s11-the-council-explains-the-p: Do the words “it may never be prorogued” mean that a council cannot be prorogued even by a pope, and that an assembled council cannot be dissolved or moved by a Roman pontiff without the council’s express consent?
flo-basel-s11-that-the-council-may-not-b: Can the present council of Basel be dissolved or moved even by the pope without the express consent of two-thirds of each deputation, then two-thirds of the general congregation, and a declaration in public session?
flo-basel-s11-that-the-place-of-the-coun: In accordance with Constance, must the place of the future council be chosen at least a month before dissolution, with the “ten years” fully completed before authorization to hold the next general council begins?
flo-basel-s11-p6-en: Before entering the conclave, must the electors of a pope swear that if one of them is elected he will observe the said decrees?
flo-basel-s11-p7-en: Are the electors of a Roman pontiff bound, before entering the conclave, to swear that if one of them is chosen pope he will observe and fulfil these decrees, and must the chosen pontiff profess effective observance of them?
flo-basel-s11-that-this-decree-should-be: So that nobody may plead ignorance of this wholesome and necessary decree, must metropolitan bishops have it read and published in provincial and synodal councils, and religious superiors in their general chapters?
flo-basel-s12-decree-on-elections-and-co: In the Church’s reformation, must pastors be such that like pillars they uphold the Church by doctrine and merits, each church electing a prelate for itself according to the sacred canons rather than by general reservation?
flo-florence-s12-eugenius-iv-convokes-th: Having returned to Rome and the Lateran, and for various just, reasonable, and necessary causes, by apostolic authority and the plenitude of power with the council’s approval, is the Lateran council convoked as that continuation?
flo-basel-s12-p2-en: Must those with the right of electing prelates be most solicitous to elect persons who can fill so great an office, remembering that fraudulent election in so important an affair brings grave guilt?
flo-florence-s12-p2-en: Did the compassionate Lord ordain that his only-begotten Son assume human nature and join it to himself in a single person so that fallen nature might be repaired and his bride the holy Church brought forth in unity and charity?
